headline: Oasis Tradelink postpones board meet to Nov 13
summary: Oasis Tradelink Ltd has postponed its board meeting scheduled for November 7, 2026, to November 13, 2026. The meeting was originally set to approve Q2FY27 financial results.

headline: Deccan Gold subsidiary signs refining deal
summary: Avelum Partner LLC, a subsidiary of Deccan Gold Mines, has signed an agreement with Kyrgyzaltyn for gold refining. The first 1.2 kg dore consignment has been dispatched to validate procedures.

headline: Neogen Chemicals gets GPCB consent for Dahej plant
summary: Neogen Chemicals received a revocation of direction and provisional consent from GPCB for its Dahej SEZ plant on November 7, 2026, following the March 2025 fire incident.
